corroborating_thread: Both reports also show LaunchServices _LSCopyLocalDatabase on a background thread while NSApplication registration aborts on the main thread.
finding: The observed failure occurs during host AppKit/LaunchServices application registration, before the eframe app callback can render a window. This points to a host launch-registration failure rather than a demonstrated product rendering defect; the exact LaunchServices failure cause is not present in the report.
next: Retry exact-package UI verification only when the host can register a native app successfully or from a verified macOS host; do not clear/rebuild the host LaunchServices database as part of this product task.
